_comment: Manually-verified Toronto events to merge into events.json on each scrape run. Scope: 2026-05-01 to 2026-12-31. Schema matches events.json entries. Dedup against the live catalog uses UnifiedTorontoScraper.is_duplicate() (normalized title + same date, with 80% word-overlap fallback). Add new entries here; the daily workflow will pick them up.
_filtering_notes: Excluded: 3 Spanish-language Eventbrite false positives, 'Adults' (too generic), 'The Small Business Show 2026' (TZ collision with May 21 baseline), '*Long Weekend NATURE WALK*' (likely dupe of Saturday walk).
